title: Two Good Friends
text:
Maria and Lucia have been friends since they were children. They live on the same street, so they often walk to school together. They also share a love of music and sing in the same choir.

Last year, Lucia moved to another city for her new job. At first, Maria felt sad because they could not see each other every day. However, they call each other every Sunday, and they still trust each other very much.

questions.text: Where do Maria and Lucia live?
How often do Maria and Lucia call each other after Lucia moves?
How does Maria probably feel about Lucia's move?
options: She is happy to be alone

questions.text: What can the reader infer about Maria and Lucia's friendship?
options: It is strong and lasts despite the distance

vocabulary.definition: a group of people who sing together
a belief that a person is honest and reliable
the work a person does to earn money

paragraph_translations: María y Lucía han sido amigas desde que eran niñas. Viven en la misma calle, así que a menudo caminan juntas a la escuela. También comparten el amor por la música y cantan en el mismo coro.

El año pasado, Lucía se mudó a otra ciudad por su nuevo trabajo. Al principio, María se sintió triste porque no podían verse todos los días. Sin embargo, se llaman cada domingo y todavía confían mucho la una en la otra.
